name: Zoo d'Amiens Métropole conservation project grants
summary: Grants from a French zoo, up to €3,000 per project, for concrete, measurable field conservation projects that benefit at least one IUCN Red List threatened species (VU/EN/CR/EW), ideally led by local actors and benefiting local people. Projects apply by email.

amount.note: Maximum per project for the year

reporting: Grantees send the zoo an annual report, along with photos and visuals it may use.

status.quote: Pour 2026, nous lançons un appel à candidature pour l'attribution de subventions d'un montant de 12 000€.
